plan.operation: Remove the RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED uses-permission and disable the receiver that handles the boot broadcast (android:enabled=false).

preconditions.name: boot_receiver_identified
preconditions.detail: boot receivers: ['de.audioattack.openlink.conf.PackageChangeBroadcastReceiver']; receivers in manifest: 2; requested: (derive)

consequences: de.audioattack.openlink.conf.PackageChangeBroadcastReceiver also handles android.intent.action.MY_PACKAGE_REPLACED; disabling the component stops those broadcasts too.
limitations: Manifest-level change only: no DEX/smali code is changed. Code that handles BOOT_COMPLETED is still present in the APK.
The receiver is disabled for every action it handles, not only for the boot action.
Code can re-enable components at runtime (PackageManager.setComponentEnabledSetting); static analysis cannot rule that out.
Other components or mechanisms (alarms, WorkManager, other receivers) that start work at or after boot are not addressed.
Does not establish runtime behaviour: the modified APK is not installed or run.
